name: Keltner first-close breakout with signal-bar stop and 2R
author: The Right Trader
instruments: liquid futures, equities, crypto; examples QQQ and BTC
entry_long: First close above upper band after previous close was inside
entry_short: First close below lower band after previous close was inside
exit: Close back inside channel or 2R target
stop_loss: Signal bar low for long / high for short
position_sizing: Risk-based sizing; exact account fraction unspecified
filters: Only first outside close; no repeated entries while outside
implementation_notes: Source explicitly says modern EMA/ATR channel differs from Chester Keltner original. Gap fills and ATR convention matter.
